title: Tester transcript
statement: For a nonadaptive tester with $r$ query positions, let $f$ map domain elements to codomain elements and fix a random seed. At each position, its transcript records the value of $f$ at the queried address if an address is specified, and records no value if that position has no query.
hypotheses_covered: A nonadaptive tester with $r$ query positions
A function from the domain to the codomain
A seed from the tester's seed space
